title: Evolith artifact registry
description: GT-650 / ADR-0125 — the single declaration of every SDLC artifact the Core knows about. Slug is the identity; `label` is display only. Replaces the two hand-maintained gate corpora and the hand-written `UNIVERSAL_PHASE_ARTIFACTS` constant, which now derive from it.

phaseVocabulary.description: The closed set of phase names an artifact may be declared in. Closed on purpose: an artifact declared in a phase nobody evaluates is invisible, and a typo would create one silently.

id.description: The stable slug. THIS is the identity — what topology manifests, the completeness service and satellites already key on.

label.description: Human name, for reports. No consumer may match on it: three labels diverge from their slug (`Security Scan Report` ⇄ `security-scan-result`, `Rollback Procedure` ⇄ `rollback-plan`, `Observability Validation` ⇄ `observability-readiness`) and a matcher would miss all three silently.

phases.description: A LIST, and that is the point of ADR-0125: `coverage-report` is required at construction AND expected at quality. Both were always true, and the two files that each stated half of it looked like a contradiction.

classification.description: `binding` — a gate requires it; its absence fails that gate. `advisory` — counted towards completeness only. The difference decides whether an artifact can block a release, so it is never inferred.

schemaId.description: The canonical schema's published `$id`. An `$id` and not a path: a path is a fact about where a file sits in one repository at one moment, and those paths were in fact broken until `#378`.

producedBy.description: Present when the artifact IS a tool's own output. Mutually exclusive with `schemaId`: `no schema yet` and `deliberately no schema` call for opposite actions, and collapsing them loses that.

not.$comment: An artifact cannot both publish a canonical schema and be a tool's native output.
